```sql
SELECT
    d.bowler,
    COUNT(*) AS wickets
FROM
    deliveries d
JOIN
    matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
WHERE
    m.season = 2022
    AND d.is_wicket = 1
    AND (d.dismissal_kind IS NULL
         OR d.dismissal_kind NOT IN ('run out', 'obstructing the field', 'retired hurt'))
GROUP BY
    d.bowler
ORDER BY
    wickets DESC
LIMIT 3;
```
